These '''elvish humanoids''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on a [[Lourdes' homeworld|small planetoid]]. They were ruled by a [[Lourdes' father|king]] until he was murdered during the invasion by the [[Yahk-Tosh]] warlord [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Gar-Oth]]. The king's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]], managed to [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoshi Raph-Elan)|kill]] the invader with the help of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|128|LOU 1-2|Princess Lourdes}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Princess Lourdes was a member of a peaceful species of elvish humanoids.|''The Official Star Wars Fact File 128''|<ref name="FF" />}}
Lourdes' species is not described in their initial appearance, [[Star Wars (1998) 27|''Star Wars'' (1998) 27]]; however, in the issue of the ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' that covered these events, she was described as an "[[Wikipedia:Elf|elvish humanoid]]".<ref name="FF" /> [[Leland Chee]], on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]], stated that his theory is that "all pointy-eared species are either [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] or closely related to Sephi."<ref name="TT">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM}}</ref>
